title: Qatl ali hogaye
body:
shab chaak gareban sehar girya kuna hai
maqlooq e khuda maa'il e faryad o fughan hai
maa bain zameen aasman mehshar ka samaa hai
uneesween ramzan ka ye haal bayan hai
tareekh ye wo hai jo qayamat se nahi kam
ay momino sar peeto karo girya o matam
<<DIVIDER>>
inna lillahe wa inna ilaihe rajeeoon
ya ali ya aeliya ya ali ya aeliya
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl ali ho gaye ramzan mein
dard hai jibreel ke aelaan mein
<<DIVIDER>>
masjid e kufa se jab gham ki ye aayi khabar
binte ali ro padi seena o sar peet kar
kufe mein ek shor tha ya ali ya aeliya
hogaya matam bapa ya ali ya aeliya
kis ne ye dhaayi jafa ya ali ya aeliya
gham hai bapa khana e yazdan mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbar o shabbir se behno ne rokar kaha
dekho to jaa kar zara kyun hai ye aah o buka
aati hai har soo sada ya ali ya aeliya
gham hai ye sab se bada ya ali ya aeliya
haye ghazab ho gaya ya ali ya aeliya
hashr bapa hai dil e veraan mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
daud ke masjid gaye shabbar o shabbir jab
baap ko is haal mein dekha ke haye ghazab
beto ne ro kar kaha ya ali ya aeliya
kyun huye humse khafa ya ali ya aeliya
khoon jo baha aap ka ya ali ya aeliya
deen e mohamed bhi hai nuqsan mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ko lekar gaye ghar mein jo dono pisar
pairon mein baithi koi koi sambhale thi sar
fizza ki aayi sada ya ali ya aeliya
jab se ye sadma mila ya ali ya aeliya
dil ka sukoon lut gaya ya ali ya aeliya
sang hai ya dil seena e insan mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe ke bewa yateem padte hai ye marsiya
koi sahara nahi maula tumhare siwa
ab ye musibat zada ya ali ya aeliya
kaise jiyenge bhala ya ali ya aeliya
aap thay gham ki dawa ya ali ya aeliya
nauha hai ye shehr e bayaban mein
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha hai kulsoom ka kis se mai poochun bhala
kyun bin e muljim ne ki baba ye tum par jafa
jurm na koi khata ya ali ya aeliya
zulm ki hai inteha ya ali ya aeliya
kunba tadapne laga ya ali ya aeliya
khaak hai baalon mein gareban mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehmaton aur barkaton waala mahina ye tha
jis mein mere baba ka khoon bahaya gaya
rehmat e mehwe buka ya ali ya aeliya
barkat e mehwe buka ya ali ya aeliya
naymat e mehwe buka ya ali ya aeliya
bughz jo tha qalb e musalman mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazhar o mesum ne ye kehke uthaya qalam
eid se pehle mila aal e mohamed ko ghum
bibiyon ka marsiya ya ali ya aeliya
aaj se hai ibteda ya ali ya aeliya
imtehan e karbala ya ali ya aeliya
nauha hai maula ke yatemaan mein
qatl ali ho gaye...
author: Mazhar Abidi
